currentScopeReview.scope: Complete one-page 16-bar short refrain/theme, printed in full and ending with a whole G4 and final barline. This scope excludes the original verse; no continuation or repeat expansion is inferred.
currentScopeReview.tempoDecision: Retain 80 quarter BPM and the historical defaultSpeedFactor 0.9 as practice choices. The source has no tempo marking; actual visible runtime speed must be recorded during playback checks.
currentScopeReview.independentReview: The actual saved source pixels were independently re-read across all four systems before adoption; all 51 pitch/onset/duration tuples agree with the earlier independent source fixture. Similar occurrences and the two different cadences were read separately.
rhythmDecisions: All 16 bars contain exactly four quarter beats, with no pickup, printed rest, tie, slur, tuplet or repeat instruction. All repeated pitches remain separate attacks.
m6 and m14 end with separate source B4 eighth notes, compiled as E5 at 23/23.5 and 55/55.5; the E5 at 24 is another attack, not a tied continuation.
m8 is D5 at 28 for two beats and G5 at 30 for two beats after transposition. m15 is G5/G5/F5/D5 at 56/57/58/59; it is not copied from the first-half cadence.
Breath commas after m4/m8/m12 are unmeasured phrasing signs. No guessed rest is inserted and no printed note is shortened.
Final compiled C5 at beat 60 lasts four beats to 64. No final rest or extra score-time ring-out is added.
currentScopeReview.versionDecision: Adopt the explicitly selected Coughlin short refrain in full. Its differences are not proof that the old edition is wrong; preserve the old source claims as historical information and never splice its timing or accompaniment into this edition.
currentScopeReview.supportDecision: No new support. Printed A7 becomes D7 containing F# under the same +5 transposition; do not naturalize it or infer a playable lower voice. The historical V2 melody/timebase is incompatible and its support must be rejected.
currentScopeReview.limitations: Notation correspondence and executable tuple checks do not establish external-reference listening, browser sound, physical-instrument acceptance or publication rights. The inspected PDF bears a Kyle Coughlin copyright notice.

suitability.reason: The source-backed single melody uses five natural pitches C5-G5 with no simultaneous targets. Fastest repeated attacks are half a beat (375 ms at the chosen 80 BPM), with at most two tine positions of same-thumb movement. Listening and physical play-through remain pending.
